notes: §1985:VI.6.18.4 GR17 runs a format 3 as a format 1 then a format 2 statement, with 'Subscripting associated with any identifier in the format 2 statement is evaluated only once before executing the format 1 statement'. InspectEmitter#IdentifyOperands freezes every operand's subscripts before the tallying pass, and EmitBody runs TALLYING, stores the counters, then REPLACING reading its data-item operands after those stores; at --std 85 InspectBinder#Bind sets ReplacingTakesLengthAnew (DialectBehavior.InspectFormat3LengthIdentifiedOnce off), so EmitBody re-reads an occurs-depending identifier-1 at its new length. Probes at 85: ODO group G (N=2, 'AAAAAA') TALLYING N REPLACING A BY B -> N 4, G 'BBBBAA' (2023 gives 'BBAAAA'); TE(S) TALLYING S REPLACING BY TE(S)(2:1) keeps S=1 for the replacement; REPLACING ALL C after TALLYING C replaces the tallied value '3'; signed S9(3) and CHARACTERS AFTER correct; INSPECT BACKWARD refused COBOL0845. The witness exercises a subscript naming the counter.

next.reason: Equivalence to two successive INSPECTs is verbatim in §2023:14.9.22.4 GR19, but 1985 'Subscripting associated with any identifier in the format 2 statement is evaluated only once before executing the format 1 statement' became 'Item identification of any identifier in the format 2 statement is done only once before executing the format 1 statement', and item identification includes 'length evaluation for an occurs-depending group item' (§2023:14.6.4 GR6). A tally into identifier-1's DEPENDING ON item no longer changes the length the REPLACING part scans: a result changed.
